verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Termius publishes an llms.txt at docs.termius.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes the documentation as agent-consumable markdown links, and the cited doc pages are served as .md files an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: any evidence of an llms-full.txt or dedicated agent-oriented guidance beyond the index, and independent/community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
